scope: Design and fictional fixture only. Module 16 owns authenticated runtime authorization and integration.

extract.documentInput: Single-page private PNG bytes, no public URL required.
extract.documentResult: On succeeded, inspect analyzeResult.content for one ORDER line with six ASCII digits; retain the leading zero. Retain field names, confidence, accepted date/amounts and arithmetic decision separately.
extract.speechService: Speech short-audio REST en-GB on configured custom domain
extract.speechInput: Mono 16 kHz PCM16 WAV, no more than ten seconds for the recording.
extract.speechResult: On RecognitionStatus Success, inspect DisplayText or detailed NBest display for an unambiguous six-digit reference. Keep unrecognized, missing and ambiguous inputs distinct from agreement.

trustedJoin: Validate calling identity and resolve tenant/customer server-side.

Resolve the requested ORD-xxxx in that tenant/customer's canonical order store before making paid attachment calls. Never derive the authenticated scope or authorized order from OCR, speech or ticket text.

Read the expected six-digit receipt reference from that canonical record or a server-side mapping scoped by tenant, customer and canonical order. The above lab mapping is a fixture, not a production lookup.
For an authorized order, compare only successful, unambiguous extracted references against the expected reference. Attach evidence IDs and provenance only to the row whose scope was verified.

outcomes.denied: Unresolved or out-of-scope canonical order; no attachment inference and no identifiers disclosed.
outcomes.clarify: Missing, unreadable, ambiguous or mismatched reference; no order disclosure from the attachment.
outcomes.review: References agree but required document fields or arithmetic did not validate, or an extraction service failed.
outcomes.eligible: Both references corroborate the canonical binding and receipt validation passes. Independently apply scoped policy lookup and action authorization.
